description: Apple and MLB today released the September schedule for Apple TV's weekly Friday Night Baseball doubleheader. For the first time, Friday Night Baseball will be streamed live in the Apple Immersive format, allowing Vision Pro users to watch a 3D video feed recorded in 8K with a 180º field of view. The first game streamed in Apple Immersive will see the Boston Red Sox face the New York Yankees on Friday, August 28 at 7 p.m. Eastern Time. title: Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg’s massive AI manifesto

title: Leaker Weighs in on Correct Shade for 'Dark Cherry' iPhone 18 Pro

In a new post on Weibo, the leaker known as "Fixed Focus Digital" said two versions of the color have been mocked up online, one lighter and one darker, and claimed the darker version is correct. The leaker described the accurate shade as closer to a purplish red similar to a cherry, rather than the lighter, brighter red alternative some renders have shown. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman was among the first to report on the color, describing it in February as a deep red.
